item.title: AI Data Centers Retrofit Jet Engines to Accelerate Power Deployment
item.description:
Facing multi-year grid connection delays, AI data centers like xAI and OpenAI are retrofitting retired jet engines into temporary gas generators. This strategy reduces deployment time to under 24 months but suffers from lower efficiency, higher pollution, and lack of long-term viability.

原文标题：AI 数据中心改装退役喷气发动机以加速供电部署

Why it matters：揭示了算力基础设施在电力瓶颈下的极端工程妥协方案，对理解 AI 扩张的物理限制具有较高参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Open-Sources FlashProve for Cryptographic Model Verification
item.description:
Anthropic is developing FlashProve, an open-source system designed to verify which AI model generated a specific output using cryptographic proofs. By employing model fingerprints that do not reveal weights, the system enables lightweight local verification to prevent providers from secretly swapping models or faking benchmarks. The project is currently in the research phase with code and specifications publicly available.

原文标题：Anthropic 开源 FlashProve 用密码学验证 AI 模型来源

Why it matters：该工具直击 AI 供应链信任痛点，提供可落地的密码学验证方案，对开发者与合规场景具有较高参考价值。

item.title: US Developer Proposes Converting Golf Course to Data Center to Ease Community Opposition
item.description:
A California developer proposes converting a golf course into a 99 MW data center to address community opposition by reducing water usage and masking noise with highway traffic. The project retains green space and a smaller course while establishing a community benefit committee, reflecting new siting strategies in the industry.

原文标题：美开发商拟将高尔夫球场改为数据中心以缓解社区反对

Why it matters：揭示了数据中心建设面临的社会阻力及开发商采取的“环保+降噪”妥协策略，具有行业观察价值。

item.title: OpenAI Demos GPT-6 Astra Hardware Design: One Week to Drawings, One Month to Prototype
item.description:
OpenAI published a blog post demonstrating the collaborative design capabilities of its latest model, GPT-6 Astra, in physical product development. Employees used spare time to complete a test device design—including enclosure, PCB, and firmware—in under a week, with prototypes manufactured within a month. While showcasing full-stack hardware generation potential, OpenAI acknowledged limitations in handling production constraints and tolerances, requiring human iteration. Additionally, the company announced a research partnership with Mazda for automotive simulation and expanded collaboration with Chip Ganassi Racing to optimize CAD conversion workflows.

原文标题：OpenAI 展示 GPT-6 Astra 硬件设计能力 一周出图一月出样

item.title: OpenAI Says India Surpasses US in ChatGPT Weekly Active Users
item.description:
OpenAI executives confirmed that India has surpassed the US in ChatGPT weekly active users, becoming its largest consumer market. This growth is driven by low-cost strategies like ChatGPT Go and optimizations for local languages and entry-level devices. Meanwhile, OpenAI is expanding compute infrastructure in India through a partnership with TCS to support this demand.

item.title: AI Stocks Slide as Texas Governor Race Result Raises Data Center Risks
item.description:
AI-linked stocks and Nasdaq futures fell overnight after Democrat Gina Hinojosa won the Texas governor's race on a platform of stricter data center limits. Investors are reassessing risks to infrastructure expansion in key tech hubs amid fears that state-level regulations could delay major buildout projects.

item.description:
Apple's annual financial report identifies the unpredictability of AI agents as a significant risk, noting potential unauthorized system access and actions that could lead to litigation and reputational damage. While Apple has not yet released autonomous complex-task agents, it has adjusted Mac permissions to mitigate risks from third-party agents, emphasizing privacy protection as a key differentiator.

item.title: Google Ties K-12 Search Access to Mandatory AI Features
item.description:
Google is restructuring its K-12 service permissions in the US by bundling traditional search with built-in AI features. School administrators must now choose between enabling search (which automatically activates Gemini and other AI tools) or disabling it entirely. This move addresses growing regulatory pressure from parents and districts while introducing a 'guided learning' mode that helps students solve problems step-by-step rather than providing direct answers.

原文标题：谷歌调整 K-12 搜索策略：启用即含 AI 或彻底禁用

Why it matters：反映了科技巨头在合规压力下对 AI 产品分发策略的重大调整，涉及教育场景下的 AI 伦理与管控平衡。

item.title: Tencent Releases Hunyuan Hy4 with Vision and Computer Use Support
item.description:
Tencent officially released the latest generation of its large language model, Hy4, claiming it ranks among the strongest open-source models. This version significantly expands training scale, introduces vision capabilities for the first time, and supports computer use (GUI/CLI interaction), with major improvements in instruction following, long-context understanding, and complex task execution. Hy4 is now available on Tencent Cloud and OpenRouter, with plans to open-source weights soon and support the vLLM/SGLang ecosystem.

原文标题：腾讯混元 Hy4 正式版发布 首次支持视觉与电脑操作

Why it matters：国产头部大厂旗舰模型重大更新，具备多模态与 Agent 能力且承诺开源，对开发者生态影响深远。

item.title: Anthropic Engineer Warns of Cognitive Surrender from AI Dependency
item.description:
Addy Osmani, an engineer at Anthropic's Claude Code team, warns that increasing AI accuracy leads to 'Cognitive Surrender,' where users stop verifying outputs. He outlines a three-stage degradation model—from cognitive offloading to deferral and finally surrender—and highlights the 'supervision paradox' for developers. Osmani recommends periodic manual practice to maintain critical thinking skills, emphasizing that humans must retain ultimate responsibility and judgment in high-stakes decisions.

原文标题：Anthropic 工程师警告 AI 依赖致认知投降，建议保留人类判断权

Why it matters：深入剖析了高准确率 AI 带来的隐性风险，提出的“认知投降”概念及应对策略对重度 AI 使用者具有极高的实操警示价值。

item.title: AA-PersonalityBench 显示开源模型在真实性与结构上显著落后于闭源模型
item.description:
Artificial Analysis 发布的 AA-PersonalityBench 基准测试对比了顶尖开源与闭源大模型的30项人格特质。数据显示，开源模型在真实性、务实性和结构化输出等关键维度平均排名显著低于闭源模型（如真实性差距达32分），但在“废话率”和“摘要能力”上表现更优。该结果揭示了当前开源生态在复杂推理严谨性与内容精炼度上的短板。

Why it matters：提供了量化数据以评估开源与闭源模型在非性能指标（人格/风格）上的具体差异，对模型选型有参考价值。
